description: A goal broken into steps, drawn as a map; every step is taught by a full subject. Product term, capitalised in English; one fixed translation everywhere. (catalog: top.curricula)
One stop on a Roadmap; each step is a subject. Called “station” on the map (same translation). (catalog: sh.nextStep)
Synonym of “step” on the Roadmap map and its legend; translate exactly like step. (catalog: sh.signRule)
What a Roadmap leads to (typed by the learner), drawn as the treasure on the map. Also the daily XP goal. (catalog: top.curriculaTitle)
The Roadmap’s goal on the map; on Progress also the medals the learner found (“Treasures you found”). (catalog: sh.treasures)
The drawing of a Roadmap (as opposed to the list view). (catalog: sh.viewMap)

Plan a Roadmap step again (e.g. to match a subject attached to it). (catalog: sh.signReplan)
